title: GEMglTexImage2D

messages.description: level-of-detail number (0 is the base image)
internal format of the texture (Gem calls this one xoffset)
width of the texture image (Gem calls this one yoffset)
height of the texture image (Gem calls this one width)
width of the border, 0 or 1 (Gem calls this one height)

arguments.description: level-of-detail number (0 is the base image)
internal format of the texture (Gem calls this one xoffset)
width of the texture image (Gem calls this one yoffset)

methods.description: texture target (no effect: [GEMglTexImage2D] always uses GL_TEXTURE_2D)

body: [GEMglTexImage2D] calls glTexImage2D() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. The image is the pix in the gemlist; its format, type and data go to the call as they are. Gem passes its inlets to glTexImage2D shifted by one: the one named xoffset sets the internal format, yoffset the width, width the height and height the border. See glTexImage2D in the OpenGL reference.
